scheme_name: Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Loan/Assistance to Medical Post Graduate Doctors of Scheduled Caste
other_conditions: Applicant must not have received any benefit under a similar government scheme
Applicants who have previously obtained loan/assistance for starting an independent profession after completing a graduate medical degree (MBBS, B.S.A.M., B.A.M.S., B.D.S.) are ineligible
Loan assistance must be used only for the purpose for which it is provided; misuse will attract penal interest
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of ₹50,000 and a loan up to ₹3,00,000 at an interest rate of 4%.
